name: aml
title: AML account check
notes: Trained on 12 synthetic worlds with planted laundering; tested on 4 others.

inputs.label: many inflows
inputs.description: Transfers received in the last 30 days.

inputs.label: many outflows
inputs.description: Transfers sent in the last 30 days.

inputs.label: large inflows
inputs.description: Total received, on a log scale.

inputs.label: passes money on
inputs.description: Share of what came in that went out within 48 h.

inputs.label: forwards within a day
inputs.description: Share of inflows forwarded, mostly intact, within 24 h.

inputs.label: deposits under the limit
inputs.description: Inflows just under the 10,000 reporting threshold.

inputs.label: new account
inputs.description: Opened recently (1 for days old, 0 for a year).

inputs.label: on a long forwarding chain
inputs.description: Hops in the longest chain of mostly-intact forwards through this account (graph).

inputs.label: money returns to a sender
inputs.description: Within 4 hops, money from this account reaches one of its senders (graph).

inputs.label: shares devices
inputs.description: Other accounts seen on this account's devices.

inputs.label: trades with new accounts
inputs.description: Share of counterparties opened in the last 30 days (graph).

inputs.label: sends to exchange or mixer
inputs.description: Sent money to an exchange or a mixer.

outputs.label: layering
outputs.description: Money walked through a chain of accounts.

outputs.label: structuring
outputs.description: Deposits split to stay under the limit.

outputs.label: round trip
outputs.description: Money sent out comes back to where it started.

outputs.label: device ring
outputs.description: Several accounts run from the same devices.
